title: The Mechanics of GPU Inference: KV Cache, PagedAttention & The Memory Wall

beats.description: High-tech datacenter laboratory; NVIDIA H100 GPU die with 2,000 TFLOPs tensor cores sits 99% idle while an exhausted chef sprints across a warehouse carrying a 140-lb crate just to slice a single cucumber; prefill vs decode contrast

Antique library desk; stickman writer must re-read all past 499 words to write word 500; animated quadratic O(N^2) computation explosion curve; introduction of KV cache bulletin board pinning Key and Value index cards

University amphitheater with glowing blackboard formula 2 * layers * heads * d * seq * batch; cold arithmetic of Llama-70B consuming 2.62 MB per token; 128k context explodes to 342 GB VRAM; multi-user OOM red alarm crash

Grand futuristic hotel with 80 locked empty rooms turning guests away; static reservation fragmentation waste; UC Berkeley PagedAttention virtual block table slicing KV cache into neat 16-token physical blocks; waste drops from 80% to 3%

Micro-architecture silicon cutaway; massive slow HBM ocean connected via narrow bridge to lightning fast on-chip SRAM cache; matrix tiling and the Online Softmax trick eliminating the quadratic N x N attention matrix materialization

Futuristic command deck; Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) merging 64 heads into 8 groups; Speculative Decoding with a swift 1B scout robot proposing 5 candidate tokens in parallel verified by the 70B flagship titan in 1 single forward pass
